subject: ss-haematology
title: Chronic lymphocytic leukaemia markers staging and treatment triggers
refs: Harrison Principles of Internal Medicine 22e Ch 112 Chronic Lymphocytic Leukemia

steps.tx: **Chronic lymphocytic leukaemia** (CLL, indolent B cell lymphoproliferative disease) is the most common adult leukaemia in western countries, striking males **2** to **1** over females. Diagnosis needs **5** times 10 to the 9 per litre (five thousand per microlitre) of monoclonal B lymphocytes in blood. **Smudge cells** (crushed lymphocytes on smear) and **CD5** (T cell marker) **CD23** (B cell marker) expression mark the classic immunophenotype.
steps.say: CLL is the commonest adult leukaemia in western countries today. Diagnosis needs five thousand clonal B cells per microlitre of blood. Smudge cells are typical, and CD5 with CD23 expression is classic.

steps.tx: Three entities share one biology. **Monoclonal B cell lymphocytosis** (MBL, low count clone without disease) carries under **half** times 10 to the 9 per litre and progresses in about **1** to **2** percent yearly. **CLL** exceeds **5** times 10 to the 9 per litre in blood, while **SLL** (small lymphocytic lymphoma) stays below that with nodal disease only. **Richter transformation** (progression to aggressive lymphoma) follows in **5** percent.
steps.say: MBL, CLL and SLL have the same biology at different tumour burdens. Richter transformation is seen in about five percent of patients. Low count MBL has a one to two percent yearly progression rate.

steps.tx: CLL favours older adults with median age near **70** years, and first degree relatives carry **eightfold** risk. **Agent Orange** (herbicide exposure) is a recognised cause, and prior hepatitis or other infections play no role. **Familial CLL** (inherited predisposition) accounts for **7** to **10** percent of cases. **Rai stage 0** (lymphocytosis only) precedes symptomatic disease by years in most patients.
steps.say: CLL affects older adults with a median age near seventy years. Relatives carry an eightfold risk of the disease. Agent Orange exposure is a recognised cause here.

steps.tx: Patients often present without symptoms, found by routine counts. **Lymphadenopathy** (enlarged nodes) and **splenomegaly** (enlarged spleen) dominate once disease advances, while **B symptoms** (fever, night sweats, weight loss) appear late. **Recurrent infections** (especially encapsulated bacteria) reflect hypogammaglobulinaemia and T cell dysfunction. **Skin lesions** (leukaemia cutis) and **autoimmune cytopenias** (low blood counts from antibodies) complicate one fifth of cases.
steps.say: Most patients present without symptoms, and routine counts reveal disease. Nodes and spleen are enlarged as disease advances over time. Autoimmune cytopenias are seen in about one fifth of cases.

steps.tx: Molecular risk decides therapy more than stage alone. **IGHV** (immunoglobulin heavy chain variable region) unmutated disease, about **40** percent, behaves aggressively, while mutated disease stays indolent. **del17p** (loss of chromosome arm 17p with **TP53** gene) confers chemoresistance and needs targeted drugs always. **del11q** (chromosome 11 loss) brings bulky nodes, and **trisomy 12** (extra chromosome 12) enriches Richter risk. **del13q** (chromosome 13 loss alone) is most favourable.
steps.say: Unmutated IGHV and del17p are markers of aggressive disease. Del17p demands targeted therapy in every single case. Del13q alone carries the most favourable outlook.

steps.tx: **Rai staging** (lymphocytosis based) runs from **0** to **4**, with stage **0** meaning lymphocytosis only and stage **4** meaning marrow failure. **Binet staging** (nodes based) runs **A** to **C**, with stage **C** defined by haemoglobin or platelets falling low. Modern practice adds **CLL IP** (prognostic index) combining age, stage, IGHV, TP53 and cytogenetics. **Beta 2 microglobulin** (blood protein) adds prognostic weight in newer scores.
steps.say: Rai staging runs from zero to four in CLL. Binet staging runs from A to C in CLL. Marrow failure is the highest stage in both systems.

steps.tx: **iwCLL indications** (treating criteria) need active disease, not stage alone. Active features include progressive marrow failure, massive or symptomatic nodes or spleen, lymphocyte doubling under **6** months, and autoimmune cytopenias refractory to steroids. **B symptoms** (weight loss above **10** percent, fever above **thirty eight** degrees, drenching sweats) qualify when present. **Watch and wait** (observation) suits asymptomatic early disease without del17p.
steps.say: Treatment starts only for active disease under iwCLL rules. Progressive marrow failure and bulky symptomatic nodes are qualifying features. Asymptomatic early disease is managed by watch and wait.

steps.tx: First line therapy for fit patients combines targeted drugs. **Venetoclax** (BCL2 blocker) with **obinutuzumab** (anti CD20 antibody) suits **TP53** wild type patients and suits older or unfit patients too. **Ibrutinib** (Bruton tyrosine kinase inhibitor, first BTK inhibitor) or **acalabrutinib** (second generation BTK inhibitor) suits del17p and other high risk patients. **Chemoimmunotherapy** (FCR regimen) survives only for **IGHV** mutated disease without TP53 faults.
steps.say: Venetoclax with obinutuzumab is standard for most fit patients today. BTK inhibitors are used for del17p and high risk disease. Chemoimmunotherapy remains only for mutated IGHV disease.

steps.tx: Long term hazards shape follow up. **Autoimmune haemolytic anaemia** (AIHA, antibody destroyed red cells) and **immune thrombocytopenia** (ITP, antibody destroyed platelets) arise in **5** to **10** percent. **Richter transformation** to diffuse large B cell lymphoma strikes **5** percent and behaves aggressively with median survival under **1** year. **Second cancers** (skin, lung, prostate) exceed population rates. **Hypogammaglobulinaemia** (low antibodies) drives infection deaths.
steps.say: Autoimmune cytopenias affect five to ten percent of patients. Richter transformation acts like aggressive lymphoma always. Second cancers exceed population rates in CLL cases.

steps.tx: Exam stems try to catch the following. **MBL** (low count clone) must not change management like CLL does. **del17p** (TP53 loss) must trigger BTK inhibitor choice, never FCR. **CD23** (marker) plus **CD5** (marker) plus smudge cells clinch CLL over mantle cell lymphoma, where cyclin D1 rules. **Ibrutinib** (BTK inhibitor) at **four hundred twenty** mg daily stays standard even without TP53 faults in many guidelines.
steps.say: FCR is never offered to del17p disease in stems. CD23 with CD5 and smudge cells are the CLL signature. MBL needs no management unlike frank CLL.

steps.tx: High-yield for the exam: diagnosis needs **five thousand** clonal B cells per microlitre with **CD5** **CD23** and smudge cells. **del17p** **TP53** demands BTK inhibitor, and **IGHV** unmutated means aggressive course. **Rai 0** is lymphocytosis only, and **Binet C** is low counts. **Venetoclax obinutuzumab** is fixed duration first line, with **ibrutinib four hundred twenty** mg daily as the classic BTK option.
steps.say: Diagnosis needs five thousand clonal B cells with CD5 and CD23. Del17p requires a BTK inhibitor every single time. Venetoclax obinutuzumab leads first line therapy.
